text:
From an empty Unreal Engine template to a playable scene.
A stylized third person village, and a Counter-Strike style FPS level.
In Acrovia Studio you will find our Unreal Engine and Blender courses. If you want to learn how to build this, go to acrovia.eu (link in bio).
Characters and environments use assets from fab.com .
